verdict.rationale: The closest evidence is that Claude can apply a team's design system to every project automatically, and can generate a dozen directions at once. Community users confirm the multi-variation prototyping. Neither amounts to user-directed bulk operations, such as batch-editing, exporting or modifying many existing items in one action. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch edit or export across multiple designs, documented multi-select operations, an API or scripting surface for bulk automation, hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
